en:
The close friend you mentioned before...
I'm sure she's thinking about you.
...Maki?

She's not here anymore.
She died.
What!? Died?

After I finished training, I went to see her.
She died in a car accident saving a child.
Oh no...

...I was shocked.
Why did I endure all that training then?
But...
She probably died happy saving someone.

And the memories of her I keep inside me
have kept me alive till now.
Even the whole orphanage.

That's why...I'll do everything I can to
protect that place.
I see...

...You look like you want to say something.
Your face is gross, so spit it out already.

I was thinking about what I can do.
What I can do for you, Maki.
Huh, for me?

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki, you're a normal girl at heart.
I want you to live a normal life...

I was thinking that...you could leave
being an assassin behind.

Perhaps...I could use my detective skills to
investigate the assassin cult?
That's impossible.
...You sound awfully sure.

The world isn't as simple as you think.
It needs assassins to do the dirty work.
That's the way the world works, huh?
Maybe, but...
But Maki, are you okay with that?
Are you unsure of something?

Who the hell do you think you are? Don't
you think you're being presumptuous?
That's the way the world works, huh?

Why don't you know this already?
You're an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> too...

Don't you know you can't do anything
with just mere words?

<CLT=cltMIND>I know, but you're carrying
all of this by yourself, Maki...
Maybe, but...

But? You think so too, but you're gonna
push the responsibility on someone else?

That's just like Kaito.
Is that guy rubbing off on you?
...I suppose that could be.
One Kaito is difficult, but two is too much.

<CLT=cltMIND>You say that...
but I can see your smile.
But Maki, are you okay with that?

Your question is unreasonable...
How do I even answer that?
...I'm sorry.

Shuichi...
Just do your best as a detective...

Why don't you try to find solutions to problems
where it won't have to lead to murder?
What?

The people I assassinate aren't killed for
simple reasons.

It happens because certain complications
occur, and can only be settled with murder.
You can...try to reduce the complications.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki pouted stubbornly and
turned her head.

And if that happens, I guess I'll have
to quit being an assassin...maybe.

No one else can do this.
You're the only one who can do it, okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>Even with her head turned, I
could see a smile on her lips.

<CLT=cltMIND>So this is how Maki
shows her thanks.

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, I realize the
situation isn't that simple.

Well, you are Kaito's sidekick,
so I shouldn't expect that much from you.

...That goes for you too, right?
Aren't you kind of his sidekick too?
...Oh, you just had to say that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki faced me with a sly grin.
I grinned back.

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't think it was possible.
The two of us, smiling together.

<CLT=cltMIND>But I know...it's because Maki and
I share a special bond.

<CLT=cltMIND>And I swear on that bond,
we will escape together!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Maki's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Financing<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I parted ways,
and I returned to my room.
